hooks.command: cmd=$(node -e "try{const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write((d.tool_input&&d.tool_input.command)||'')}catch(e){}"); case "$cmd" in "git push"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; base="origin/main"; git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} >/dev/null 2>&1 && base="@{u}"; changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base"..HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$changed" ] && exit 0; app_changed=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(app/|lib/|prisma/schema\.prisma|data/chapters/.*\.json)' || true); docs_changed=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^docs/build-plan\.md$' || true); if [ -n "$app_changed" ] && [ -z "$docs_changed" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Reminder: this push changes app/lib/schema/chapter-config files but docs/build-plan.md was not touched in these commits. Double check the Phase Plan and Data Model sections are still accurate.\", \"continue\": true}"; fi; exit 0
